name: dewfpga
description: Choose the top module for a dewfpga build, open the fresh VCD after a simulation, and show Icarus's constant-select 'sorry' as a warning instead of an error.

commands.title: dewfpga: forget the remembered top module for this folder
dewfpga: use the dewfpga iverilog lint shim (constant-select 'sorry' becomes a warning)
dewfpga: stop using the dewfpga iverilog lint shim

dewfpga.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the `dewfpga` command. Empty: `/opt/homebrew/bin/dewfpga`, then `/usr/local/bin/dewfpga`, then `~/.dewfpga/bin/dewfpga`, then `~/fpga/dewfpga/bin/dewfpga` (the first that exists). VS Code does not see your terminal's PATH, so a relative name is refused.
